vd_make_vassal_description: Click the overlord first, then the kingdom that becomes its vassal

vd_tip_not_vassal: This kingdom is not a vassal

kingdom_trait_vd_gov_city_state_info: A realm of a single city

kingdom_trait_vd_gov_empire_info: A vast realm of six or more cities
kingdom_trait_vd_gov_duchy_info: A vassal sworn to an overlord

vd_tip_city_released: $vassal$ was released from $lord$ as its vassal

vd_tip_pick_transfer_target: Transferring $city$. Now select the receiving kingdom
vd_tip_transfer_capital: Capitals cannot be transferred; use Annex Kingdom to merge a whole kingdom

vd_tip_pick_annexed: Annexer: $kingdom$. Now select the kingdom to absorb
